title: Assumed river sections request (assumed-river-sections-request-v1)
description: Input for hydrodynamics.river_section_selection: assumed river crossing points on the outer mesh boundary plus the DEM main-channel rule parameters. Sections are assumed and non-authoritative; the selection is a terrain heuristic, not a hydraulic determination. Coordinates are in the mesh CRS (projected, metres); no CRS transformation is performed.

crs.description: Projected CRS of the section points. Must be equivalent to the mesh artifact coordinate_system and to the DEM CRS (pyproj equivalence; string comparison without pyproj). Error code: crs_mismatch / dem_crs_mismatch.

sections.description: Section names must be unique (error: duplicate_section).

max_point_distance_m.description: Maximum allowed distance (m) between a section point and the nearest outer-boundary edge midpoint. Error code: point_far_from_boundary.

dem_sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 the DEM GeoTIFF must match (error: dem_sha256_mismatch).

name.description: Short section key used in the audit and in open boundary groups.

xy.description: [x, y] in the mesh CRS (m); typically the OSM waterway / boundary intersection.

discharge_series_column.description: Column of the discharge series (m3/s) that will feed this section.

ChannelRule.description: DEM main-channel rule parameters. Errors: parameter_type, parameter_range. Additional constraints: thalweg_search_m <= window_m, gap_tolerance_m <= window_m, 2 * window_m < outer loop perimeter.

window_m.description: Half-width (m) of the boundary arclength window around the nearest edge.

thalweg_search_m.description: Half-width (m) of the arclength range in which the lowest mean-elevation edge (thalweg) is sought.

bank_percentile.description: Percentile (%) of window edge mean elevations taken as the bank level.

thalweg_margin_m.description: Threshold candidate = thalweg elevation + thalweg_margin_m (m); threshold = max of the two candidates.

gap_tolerance_m.description: Cumulative length (m) of above-threshold edges tolerated inside the run when a below-threshold edge follows.

dem_samples_per_edge.description: Number k of raw DEM samples per edge at fractions (2j+1)/(2k); k=5 gives 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9.
